novelty_definition.definition: A persistent AI-generated health-state mutation is admissible only when the system can verify continuity to the exact governed disclosure actually supplied to the inference that produced the proposal lineage, while independently revalidating current state, governance, consent, actor/purpose/task, and required dependencies at commit time.

forbidden_claims.rationale: Prior work in database systems, agent memory (MemTX/MemTxn), and provenance already established these individual concepts.
Security is conditional on threat model and audited boundaries; formal exploration is bounded, and TOCTOU is subject to statistical upper bounds on tested schedules.
GLHS is a systems safety and transaction invariant, not a clinical diagnostic efficacy validation.
Compact capabilities (e.g. Macaroons, MIN_READSET_TOKEN) can achieve similar validation semantics under differing trade-offs.

forbidden_claims.condition: Requires verified provider ledger with requested and reported model IDs in artifact directory; synthetic responses cannot support provider claims.
Must execute against live PostgreSQL server instances with backend attestation; Python thread lock simulations are prohibited from making PostgreSQL claims.
Internal LLM subagents (e.g. Agent E) are internal verification tools and must never be characterized as independent external human reviewers.
